description:
⭐️Islanders Welcome To the Villa @ Nashville!

⭐️Enjoy the energy of the city. Walk to Broadway!

⭐️Safe Location in The Music City

**One designated gated parking spot for $35 a night** note: other surrounding parking lots charge up to $60 a night. 

Permit #2018068423

The space
★ The Villa 

★ 1 Full Bed, 2 Twin Trundle Beds

★ Very Cozy and Spacious 

★ Smart TV with Netflix, Apple TV, YouTube, Peacock! Login into your account and watch your favorites!

★ Coffee Maker 

★ Kitchen Essentials 

★ Fresh Towels, Hair Dryer 

★ MAKEUP BAR FOR THE GIRLIES 

★ In-Suite Washer and Dryer 

★ Black out curtains 

★ High Speed WiFi 

★ Pool with Furniture 

★ Courtyard with Cabana, Fire pits, Grills

★ On site maintenance and security

★ Guaranteed Parking available for 1 car for a nightly fee. Additional parking available in guest Parking or local lots and garages 

★ Top Floor with Private Balcony

✈️10 minute drive to Nashville Airport 

🌃Downtown Nashville, Walk to 

Tennessee Performing Arts Center
Country Music Hall of Fame
Ryman Auditorium 
Massey Performing Arts Center
Ascend Amphitheater 
Nissan Stadium 
Bridgestone Arena 
All the Honky Tonks

Guest access
★ Download the DOOR app by DOOR Inc to access the building, amenities, and the apartment. 

★ All access to whole apartment building including lobby, pool, gym, courtyard, balcony. 

★ One assigned gated parking spot can be used for a nightly fee during your stay! ($35) 
Note other local lots charge between $40-$60 per day. 

★ There is paid guest parking. Prices may vary for additional outdoor parking in surrounding areas.

Other things to note
★ Please be aware that we are not liable for any closure or unavailability of shared amenities, as these are outside our control. Should such issues occur, we are unable to provide refunds for your stay 

★ No stairs necessary to enter unit 

★ Guest will need a smart device to access unit and building
